title: ModuleCategoryService
responsibility: Reads the project responsibility taxonomy for authoring, structural audit and revision-bound catalogs.

inputs.name: ModuleCategoryService.load.directory
inputs.description: Starting directory for the upward search, resolved to an absolute path with resolve(), so a relative value is measured from the process working directory. The search checks each directory for harness.groups.json, including the first directory that contains a .git entry, and stops at the filesystem root when no .git entry appears first.

inputs.name: ModuleCategoryService.at.tree
inputs.description: Readable source tree of the selected revision, which the class comment describes as an immutable source tree. at calls only tree.read(moduleGroupsFile), where moduleGroupsFile is 'harness.groups.json', and parses the awaited value only when it is a string.

outputs.name: ModuleCategoryService.load
outputs.description: Object with root, the absolute directory of the nearest harness.groups.json found by the upward search (the starting directory or one of its ancestors), and config, its validated ModuleGroupsConfig. The value is undefined when no harness.groups.json is found in the directories searched, which end at the first directory with a .git entry or at the filesystem root, and an invalid file throws ExpectedCliError instead.

outputs.name: ModuleCategoryService.at
outputs.description: The validated ModuleGroupsConfig parsed from the harness.groups.json text that tree.read returns, or undefined when read throws or returns a value that is not a string. Invalid text rejects with ExpectedCliError rather than resolving to undefined.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown by fail() inside parseGroups when the category text is not valid JSON or fails moduleGroupsConfig validation, such as a non-kebab-case or 'uncategorized' id, duplicate ids, or an unknown field. load throws it synchronously, and at rejects with it because its parsing runs outside the try block around tree.read.
